people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.
translations.bsb: And when Rebekah looked up and saw Isaac, she got down from her camel
translations.kjv: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
translations.asv: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she alighted from the camel.
